Chapter 9

Pods and NamespacesPod 与 Namespace

The most important primitive in the Kubernetes API is the Pod. A Pod lets you run a containerized application. In practice, you’ll often encounter a one-to-one mapping between a Pod and a container; however, there are use cases that benefit from declaring more than one container in a single Pod.

Kubernetes API 中最重要的原语是 Pod。Pod 让你运行容器化应用。实践中，你经常会遇到 Pod 与容器一一对应的情况；但也有一些使用场景会从单个 Pod 中声明多个容器中受益。

Multi-container Pods are useful for tightly coupled processes that need to share resources like storage volumes and network namespace, fulfilling use cases such as sidecar patterns (log collection, monitoring agents), adapter patterns (standardizing output formats), ambassador patterns (proxy connections), and init containers (performing setup tasks before main containers start). See the Kubernetes blog for an overview.

多容器 Pod 适用于需要共享存储卷、网络命名空间等资源的紧耦合进程，可满足 sidecar 模式（日志采集、监控 agent）、adapter 模式（标准化输出格式）、ambassador 模式（代理连接）以及 init 容器（在主容器启动前执行初始化任务）等场景。概览请参见 Kubernetes 博客。

In addition to running a container, a Pod can consume other services like storage, configuration data, and much more. Therefore, think of a Pod as a wrapper for running containers while at the same time being able to mix in cross-cutting and specialized Kubernetes features.

除了运行容器，Pod 还可以消费存储、配置数据等其他服务。因此，可以把 Pod 看作运行容器的外壳，同时又能融入横切的、专门的 Kubernetes 特性。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

The curriculum doesn’t explicitly mention coverage of Pods and namespaces. However, you will definitely need to understand those primitives as they are essential for running workloads in Kubernetes.

考试大纲没有明确提及对 Pod 和命名空间的覆盖。但你肯定需要理解这些原语，因为它们是在 Kubernetes 中运行工作负载的基础。

— PDF p.133 —

Working with Pods使用 Pod

In this chapter, we will look at working with a Pod running only a single container. I’ll discuss all important kubectl commands for creating, modifying, interacting, and deleting using imperative and declarative approaches.

在本章中，我们将讨论运行单个容器的 Pod。我会用 imperative（命令式）和 declarative（声明式）两种方式，讨论创建、修改、交互和删除所用的所有重要 kubectl 命令。

Creating Pods创建 Pod

The Pod definition needs to state an image for every container. Upon creating the Pod object, imperatively or declaratively, the scheduler will assign the Pod to a node, and the container runtime engine will check if the container image already exists on that node. If the image doesn’t exist yet, the engine will download it from a container image registry defined as default by the container runtime. As soon as the image exists on the node, the container is instantiated and will run. Figure 9-1 demonstrates the execution flow.

Pod 定义需要为每个容器声明一个镜像。无论是以命令式还是声明式创建 Pod 对象，调度器都会把 Pod 分配到某个节点，容器运行时引擎会检查该节点上是否已存在该容器镜像。如果镜像尚不存在，引擎会从容器运行时默认配置的镜像仓库下载。一旦节点上存在该镜像，容器就会被实例化并运行。图 9-1 展示了这一执行流程。

The run command is the central entry point for creating Pods imperatively. Let’s talk about its usage and the most important command-line options you should memorize and practice. Say you wanted to run a Hazelcast instance inside of a Pod. The container should use the latest Hazelcast image, expose port 5701, and define an environment variable. In addition, you also want to assign two labels to the Pod. The following imperative command combines this information and does not require any further editing of the live object:

run 命令是命令式创建 Pod 的主要入口。下面讨论它的用法以及你应当记忆和练习的最重要命令行选项。假设你想在 Pod 中运行一个 Hazelcast 实例。容器应使用最新的 Hazelcast 镜像、暴露 5701 端口，并定义一个环境变量。此外，你还想给 Pod 打两个标签。下面这条命令式命令把这些信息组合在一起，并且不需要再对线上对象做任何编辑：

$ kubectl run hazelcast --image=hazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7 \
  --port=5701 --env="DNS_DOMAIN=cluster" --labels="app=hazelcast,env=prod"
— PDF p.134 —

The run command offers a wealth of command-line options. Execute the kubectl run --help or refer to the Kubernetes documentation for a broad overview. For the exam, you’ll not need to understand every command. Table 9-1 lists the most commonly used options.

run 命令提供大量命令行选项。执行 kubectl run --help 或参阅 Kubernetes 文档可获得广泛概览。考试中你不需要理解每一个命令。表 9-1 列出了最常用的选项。

Table 9-1. Important kubectl run command-line options

表 9-1. 重要的 kubectl run 命令行选项

OptionExample valueDescription
--imagehazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7The image for the container to run.
--imagehazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7要运行的容器所用镜像。
--port5701The port that this container exposes.
--port5701该容器暴露的端口。
--rmtrueDeletes the Pod after command in the container finishes. See “Creating a Temporary Pod” on page 118.
--rmtrue容器内命令结束后删除 Pod。参见第 118 页 “创建临时 Pod”。
--envDNS_DOMAIN=clusterThe environment variables to set in the container.
--envDNS_DOMAIN=cluster要在容器中设置的环境变量。
--labelsapp=hazelcast,env=prodA comma-separated list of labels to apply to the Pod.
--labelsapp=hazelcast,env=prod以逗号分隔、应用到 Pod 上的标签列表。

Some developers are more used to creating Pods from a YAML manifest. You’re probably already accustomed to the declarative approach because it provides version-controllable, reproducible infrastructure as code that can be stored in Git, enabling GitOps workflows, peer review, and rollback capabilities. You can express the same configuration for the Hazelcast Pod by opening the editor, copying a Pod YAML code snippet from the Kubernetes online documentation, and modifying it to your needs. Example 9-1 shows the Pod manifest saved in the file pod.yaml:

有些开发者更习惯从 YAML manifest 创建 Pod。你可能已经熟悉声明式方式，因为它提供可版本控制、可复现的基础设施即代码，可以存入 Git，从而支持 GitOps 工作流、同行评审和回滚能力。你可以打开编辑器、从 Kubernetes 在线文档复制一段 Pod YAML 代码片段并按需修改，从而为 Hazelcast Pod 表达相同的配置。示例 9-1 展示了保存在 pod.yaml 文件中的 Pod manifest：

Example 9-1. Pod YAML manifest

示例 9-1. Pod YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hazelcast
  labels:
    app: hazelcast
    env: prod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: hazelcast
    image: hazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7
    env:
    - name: DNS_DOMAIN
      value: cluster
    ports:
    - containerPort: 5701
  • Assigns the name of hazelcast to the Pod把名称 hazelcast 赋给该 Pod
  • Specifies labels to the Pod为 Pod 指定标签
  • Declares the container image to be executed in the container of the Pod声明要在 Pod 容器中执行的容器镜像
  • Injects one or many environment variables to the container向容器注入一个或多个环境变量
  • Number of port to expose on the Pod’s IP address要在 Pod IP 地址上暴露的端口号
— PDF p.135 —

Creating the Pod from the manifest is straightforward. Simply use the create or apply command, as shown here and explained in “Managing Objects” on page 24:

从 manifest 创建 Pod 非常直接。只需使用 create 或 apply 命令，如下所示，并参见第 24 页 “管理对象”中的解释：

$ kubectl apply -f pod.yaml
pod/hazelcast created

Listing Pods列出 Pod

Now that you have created a Pod, you can further inspect its runtime information. The kubectl command offers a command for listing all Pods running in the cluster: get pods. The following command renders the Pod named hazelcast:

现在你已经创建了一个 Pod，可以进一步检查其运行时信息。kubectl 提供了列出集群中所有运行 Pod 的命令：get pods。下面这条命令渲染了名为 hazelcast 的 Pod：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
hazelcast   1/1     Running   0          17s

Real-world Kubernetes clusters can run hundreds of Pods at the same time. If you know the name of the Pod of interest, it’s often easier to query by name. You would still see only a single Pod:

真实世界的 Kubernetes 集群可能同时运行数百个 Pod。如果你知道感兴趣的 Pod 名称，按名称查询通常更方便。你仍然只会看到一个 Pod：

$ kubectl get pods hazelcast
NAME        READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
hazelcast   1/1     Running   0          17s

Since we’re covering basic Pod listing, it’s worth mentioning kubectl get pods | grep <pattern> as a practical alternative to exact name lookups, especially when searching for Pods created by Deployments where names include generated suffixes—for example, kubectl get pods | grep nginx finds all NGINX-related Pods regardless of their full generated names.

既然在讨论基本的 Pod 列出，值得一提的是 kubectl get pods | grep <pattern> 作为精确名称查找的实用替代方式，尤其是在搜索由 Deployment 创建、名称中带生成后缀的 Pod 时——例如 kubectl get pods | grep nginx 会找到所有与 NGINX 相关的 Pod，而不管其完整生成名称是什么。

Even better is using label selectors like kubectl get pods -l app=hazelcast, which queries Pods by their labels rather than names, making it more precise and Kubernetes-native than grep while also working across namespaces with -A or --all-namespaces.

更优的方式是使用标签选择器，例如 kubectl get pods -l app=hazelcast，它按标签而非名称查询 Pod，比 grep 更精确、更具 Kubernetes 原生性，同时配合 -A 或 --all-namespaces 还能跨命名空间工作。

Pod Lifecycle PhasesPod 生命周期阶段

Because Kubernetes is a state engine with asynchronous control loops, it’s possible that the status of the Pod doesn’t show a Running status right away when listing the Pods. It usually takes a couple of seconds to retrieve the image and start the container.

由于 Kubernetes 是一个带异步控制回路的状态引擎，列出 Pod 时其状态可能不会立刻显示为 Running。拉取镜像并启动容器通常需要几秒钟。

— PDF p.136 —

Upon Pod creation, the object goes through several lifecycle phases, as shown in Figure 9-2.

Pod 创建后，该对象会经历若干生命周期阶段，如图 9-2 所示。

Understanding the implications of each phase is important, as it gives you an idea about the operational status of a Pod. For example, during the exam you may be asked to identify a Pod with an issue and further debug the object. Table 9-2 describes all Pod lifecycle phases.

理解每个阶段的含义很重要，因为它能让你了解 Pod 的运行状态。例如，考试中你可能被要求识别出有问题的 Pod 并进一步调试该对象。表 9-2 描述了所有 Pod 生命周期阶段。

Table 9-2. Pod lifecycle phases

表 9-2. Pod 生命周期阶段

OptionDescription
PendingThe Pod has been accepted by the Kubernetes system, but one or more of the container images has not been created.
PendingPod 已被 Kubernetes 系统接受，但一个或多个容器镜像尚未创建。
RunningAt least one container is still running or is in the process of starting or restarting.
Running至少有一个容器仍在运行，或正在启动/重启过程中。
SucceededAll containers in the Pod terminated successfully.
SucceededPod 中所有容器都已成功终止。
FailedContainers in the Pod terminated, at least one failed with an error.
FailedPod 中容器已终止，至少有一个以错误结束。
UnknownThe state of the Pod could not be obtained.
Unknown无法获取 Pod 的状态。

The Pod lifecycle phases should not be confused with container states within a Pod. Containers can have one of the three possible states: Waiting, Running, and Terminated. You can read more about container states in the Kubernetes documentation.

不要把 Pod 生命周期阶段与 Pod 内容器的状态混淆。容器可能处于三种状态之一：Waiting（等待）、Running（运行中）和 Terminated（已终止）。关于容器状态的更多信息请阅读 Kubernetes 文档。

Container-Level Restarts容器级重启

Every Pod provides container-level restart capabilities. If a container fails, the kubelet cluster component will restart it based on its configured restart policy.

每个 Pod 都提供容器级重启能力。如果容器失败，kubelet 集群组件会根据其配置的重启策略重启它。

The restart policy of a Pod can be set using the attribute spec.restartPolicy. Possible values for this attribute include Always, OnFailure, and Never, as shown in Table 9-3. The default value is Always if the attribute has not been set explicitly.

Pod 的重启策略可以用 spec.restartPolicy 属性设置。该属性的可选值包括 Always、OnFailure 和 Never，如表 9-3 所示。如果未显式设置该属性，默认值为 Always。

— PDF p.137 —

Table 9-3. Container-level restart options

表 9-3. 容器级重启选项

OptionDescription
AlwaysAutomatically restarts the container after any termination
Always任何终止后自动重启容器
OnFailureOnly restarts the container if it exits with an error (non-zero exit status)
OnFailure仅当容器以错误退出（非零退出状态）时才重启
NeverDoes not automatically restart the terminated container
Never不自动重启已终止的容器

Example 9-2 shows the usage of the attribute in a Pod manifest.

示例 9-2 展示了该属性在 Pod manifest 中的用法。

Example 9-2. Setting a Pod’s restart policy

示例 9-2. 设置 Pod 的重启策略

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: hazelcast
spec:
  containers:
  - name: hazelcast
    image: hazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7
  restartPolicy: Never

The attribute applies to a Pod’s application containers and init containers (both regular init containers and sidecar containers). Sidecar containers require restartPolicy: Always to be explicitly set.

该属性适用于 Pod 的应用容器和 init 容器（包括普通 init 容器和 sidecar 容器）。sidecar 容器需要显式设置 restartPolicy: Always。

Rendering Pod Details渲染 Pod 详情

The rendered table produced by the get command provides high-level information about a Pod. But what if you needed a deeper look at the details? The describe command can help:

get 命令产生的渲染表格提供了关于 Pod 的高层信息。但如果你需要更深入地查看详情呢？describe 命令可以帮忙：

$ kubectl describe pods hazelcast
Name:               hazelcast
Namespace:          default
Priority:           0
PriorityClassName:  <none>
Node:               docker-desktop/192.168.65.3
Start Time:         Wed, 20 May 2020 19:35:47 -0600
Labels:             app=hazelcast
                    env=prod
Annotations:        <none>
Status:             Running
IP:                 10.1.0.41
Containers:
  ...
Events:
  ...
— PDF p.138 —

The terminal output contains the metadata information of a Pod, the containers it runs, and the event log, such as failures when the Pod was scheduled. The example output has been condensed to show just the metadata section. You can expect the output to be lengthy.

终端输出包含 Pod 的元数据信息、它运行的容器以及事件日志，例如 Pod 调度时的失败。示例输出已被精简为只显示元数据部分。你可以预期输出会很长。

There’s a way to be more specific about the information you want to render. You can combine the describe command with a Unix grep command if you want to identify the image for running in the container:

有办法让你更精确地指定要渲染的信息。如果想识别容器中运行的镜像，可以把 describe 命令与 Unix grep 命令结合起来：

$ kubectl describe pods hazelcast | grep Image:
    Image:          hazelcast/hazelcast:5.1.7

Accessing Logs of a Pod访问 Pod 日志

As application developers, we know very well what to expect in the log files produced by the application we implemented. Runtime failures may occur when operating an application in a container. The logs command downloads the log output of a container. The following output indicates that the Hazelcast server started up successfully:

作为应用开发者，我们非常清楚自己实现的应用所产生的日志文件中应包含什么。在容器中运行应用时可能出现运行时失败。logs 命令下载容器的日志输出。下面的输出表明 Hazelcast 服务器已成功启动：

$ kubectl logs hazelcast
...
May 25, 2020 3:36:26 PM com.hazelcast.core.LifecycleService
INFO: [10.1.0.46]:5701 [dev] [4.0.1] [10.1.0.46]:5701 is STARTED

It’s very likely that more log entries will be produced as soon as the container receives traffic from end users. You can stream the logs with the command-line option -f. This option is helpful if you want to see logs in real time.

一旦容器收到终端用户的流量，很可能会产生更多日志条目。你可以用命令行选项 -f 来流式跟踪日志。如果想实时查看日志，这个选项很有用。

Kubernetes tries to restart a container under certain conditions, such as if the image cannot be resolved on the first try. Upon a container restart, you won’t have access to the logs of the previous container; the logs command renders the logs only for the current container. However, you can still get back to the logs of the previous container by adding the -p command-line option. You may want to use that option to identify the root cause that triggered a container restart.

Kubernetes 会在某些条件下尝试重启容器，例如镜像第一次解析失败时。容器重启后，你将无法访问前一个容器的日志；logs 命令只渲染当前容器的日志。不过，加上命令行选项 -p 仍可回到前一个容器的日志。你可能想用这个选项来识别触发容器重启的根因。

Executing a Command in Container在容器中执行命令

Some situations require you to get the shell to a running container and explore the filesystem. Maybe you want to inspect the configuration of your application or debug its current state. You can use the exec command to open a shell in the container to explore it interactively, as follows:

某些情况下，你需要拿到运行中容器的 shell 并探查文件系统。也许你想检查应用的配置或调试其当前状态。可以用 exec 命令在容器中打开 shell 以交互式地探查，如下所示：

$ kubectl exec -it hazelcast -- /bin/sh
# ...
— PDF p.139 —

Notice that you do not have to provide the resource type. This command only works for a Pod. The two dashes (--) separate the exec command and its options from the command you want to run inside of the container.

注意你无需提供资源类型。该命令只对 Pod 有效。两个连字符（--）把 exec 命令及其选项与你想在容器内运行的命令分隔开。

It’s also possible to execute a single command inside of a container. Say you wanted to render the environment variables available to containers without having to be logged in. Just remove the interactive flag -it and provide the relevant command after the two dashes:

也可以在容器内执行单条命令。假设你想不必登录进去就能渲染容器可用的环境变量。只需去掉交互标志 -it，并在两个连字符后给出相关命令：

$ kubectl exec hazelcast -- env
...
DNS_DOMAIN=cluster

Creating a Temporary Pod创建临时 Pod

The command executed inside of a Pod—usually an application implementing business logic—is meant to run infinitely. Once the Pod has been created, it will stick around. Under certain conditions, you’ll want to execute a command in a Pod just for troubleshooting. This use case doesn’t require a Pod object to run beyond the execution of the command. That’s where temporary Pods come into play.

在 Pod 内执行的命令（通常是实现业务逻辑的应用）本意是无限运行。Pod 一旦创建就会一直存在。在某些情况下，你只是为了排查问题而想在 Pod 中执行一条命令。这种使用场景不需要 Pod 对象在命令执行完之后继续存在。这正是临时 Pod 发挥作用的地方。

The run command provides the flag --rm, which will automatically delete the Pod after the command running inside of it finishes. Say you want to render all environment variables using env to see what’s available inside of the container. The following command achieves exactly that:

run 命令提供了 --rm 标志，它会在 Pod 内运行的命令结束后自动删除 Pod。假设你想使用 env 渲染所有环境变量，看看容器内有哪些可用。下面这条命令正好做到这一点：

$ kubectl run busybox --image=busybox:1.36.1 --rm -it --restart=Never -- env
...
HOSTNAME=busybox
pod "busybox" deleted

The last message rendered in the output clearly states that the Pod was deleted after command execution.

输出中渲染的最后一条消息清楚地表明 Pod 在命令执行后被删除了。

Using a Pod’s IP Address for Network Communication使用 Pod 的 IP 地址进行网络通信

Every Pod is assigned an IP address upon creation. You can inspect a Pod’s IP address by using the -o wide command-line option for the get pod command or by describing the Pod. The IP address of the Pod in the following console output is 10.244.0.5:

每个 Pod 在创建时都会被分配一个 IP 地址。你可以使用 get pod 命令的 -o wide 命令行选项，或通过 describe 该 Pod 来查看其 IP 地址。下面控制台输出中 Pod 的 IP 地址是 10.244.0.5：

$ kubectl run nginx --image=nginx:1.25.1 --port=80
pod/nginx created
$ kubectl get pod nginx -o wide
NAME    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   IP           NODE       \
NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
nginx   1/1     Running   0          37s   10.244.0.5   minikube   \
<none>           <none>
$ kubectl get pod nginx -o yaml
...
status:
  podIP: 10.244.0.5
...
— PDF p.140 —

The IP address assigned to a Pod is unique across all nodes and namespaces. This is achieved by assigning a dedicated subnet to each node when registering it. When creating a new Pod on a node, the IP address is leased from the assigned subnet. This is handled by the networking lifecycle manager kube-proxy along with the Domain Name System (DNS) and the Container Network Interface (CNI).

分配给 Pod 的 IP 地址在所有节点和命名空间中是唯一的。这是通过在每个节点注册时为其分配一个专用子网来实现的。在节点上新建 Pod 时，IP 地址从所分配的子网中租出。这由网络生命周期管理器 kube-proxy 配合域名系统（DNS）和容器网络接口（CNI）共同处理。

You can easily verify the behavior by creating a temporary Pod that calls the IP address of another Pod using the command-line tool curl or wget:

你可以轻松验证这一行为：创建一个临时 Pod，使用命令行工具 curl 或 wget 调用另一个 Pod 的 IP 地址：

$ kubectl run busybox --image=busybox:1.36.1 --rm -it --restart=Never \
  -- wget 10.244.0.5:80
Connecting to 10.244.0.5:80 (10.244.0.5:80)
saving to 'index.html'
index.html           100% |********************************|   615  0:00:00 ETA
'index.html' saved
pod "busybox" deleted

Configuring Pods配置 Pod

The curriculum expects you to feel comfortable with editing YAML manifests either as files or as live object representations. This section shows you some typical configuration scenarios you may face during the exam. Later chapters will deepen your knowledge by touching on other configuration aspects.

考试大纲期望你能够熟练编辑 YAML manifest，无论是作为文件还是作为线上对象表示。本节展示你在考试中可能遇到的一些典型配置场景。后续章节会通过讨论其他配置方面来加深你的理解。

Declaring environment variables声明环境变量

Applications need to expose a way to make their runtime behavior configurable. For example, you may want to inject the URL to an external web service or declare the username for a database connection. Environment variables are a common option to provide this runtime configuration.

应用需要暴露一种使其运行时行为可配置的方式。例如，你可能想注入外部 Web 服务的 URL，或声明数据库连接的用户名。环境变量是提供这种运行时配置的常见选项。

Avoid creating container images per environment避免为每个环境创建容器镜像

It might be tempting to say, “Hey, let’s create a container image for any target deployment environment we need, including its configuration.” That’s a bad idea. One of the practices of continuous delivery and the Twelve-Factor App principles is to build a deployable artifact for a commit just once. In this case, the artifact is the container image. Deviating configuration runtime behavior should be controllable by injecting runtime information when instantiating the container. You can use environment variables to control the behavior as needed.

你可能会忍不住想：“嘿，让我们为每个需要的目标部署环境都创建一个包含其配置的容器镜像吧。”这是个坏主意。持续交付和十二要素应用原则的实践之一是：对一个提交只构建一次可部署产物。在这里，产物就是容器镜像。不同的配置运行时行为应在实例化容器时通过注入运行时信息来控制。你可以根据需要使用环境变量来控制行为。

— PDF p.141 —

Defining environment variables in a Pod YAML manifest is relatively easy. Add or enhance the section env of a container. Every environment variable consists of a key-value pair, represented by the attributes name and value. Kubernetes does not enforce or sanitize typical naming conventions for environment variable keys, though it is recommended to follow the standard of using uppercase letters and using the underscore character (_) to separate words.

在 Pod YAML manifest 中定义环境变量相对简单。添加或增强容器的 env 部分。每个环境变量由一个键值对构成，由 name 和 value 属性表示。Kubernetes 不强制要求或清洗环境变量键的典型命名约定，但建议遵循使用大写字母、并用下划线（_）分隔单词的标准。

To illustrate a set of environment variables, look at Example 9-3. The code snippet describes a Pod that runs a Java-based application using the Spring Boot framework.

为说明一组环境变量，请看示例 9-3。该代码片段描述了一个运行基于 Spring Boot 框架的 Java 应用的 Pod。

Example 9-3. YAML manifest for a Pod defining environment variables

示例 9-3. 定义环境变量的 Pod YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: spring-boot-app
spec:
  containers:
  - name: spring-boot-app
    image: springio/gs-spring-boot-docker
    env:
    - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
      value: dev
    - name: VERSION
      value: '1.5.3'

The first environment variable, named SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE, defines a pointer to a so-called profile. Spring uses profiles to manage environment-specific properties. Here, we are pointing to the profile that configures the production environment. The environment variable VERSION specifies the application version. Its value can be exposed by the running application to display the value in the user interface.

第一个环境变量名为 SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE，它定义了指向所谓 profile 的指针。Spring 使用 profile 来管理环境相关属性。这里我们指向配置生产环境的 profile。环境变量 VERSION 指定应用版本。运行中的应用可以把它的值暴露出来，在用户界面中显示。

Defining a command with arguments定义带参数的命令

Many container images already define an ENTRYPOINT or CMD instruction. The command assigned to the instruction is automatically executed as part of the container startup. For example, the Hazelcast image we used earlier defines the instruction CMD ["/opt/hazelcast/start-hazelcast.sh"].

许多容器镜像已经定义了 ENTRYPOINT 或 CMD 指令。赋给该指令的命令会在容器启动时自动执行。例如，我们之前使用的 Hazelcast 镜像定义了指令 CMD ["/opt/hazelcast/start-hazelcast.sh"]。

In a Pod definition, you can either redefine the image ENTRYPOINT and CMD instructions or assign a command to execute for the container if it hasn’t been specified by the image. You can provide this information with the help of the command and args attributes for a container. The command attribute overrides the image’s ENTRYPOINT instruction. The args attribute replaces the CMD instruction of an image.

在 Pod 定义中，你可以重新定义镜像的 ENTRYPOINT 和 CMD 指令；如果镜像未指定，也可以为容器指定要执行的命令。你可以借助容器的 command 和 args 属性提供这些信息。command 属性覆盖镜像的 ENTRYPOINT 指令。args 属性替换镜像的 CMD 指令。

Imagine you wanted to provide a command to an image that doesn’t provide one yet. As usual, there are two different approaches: imperative and declarative. We’ll generate the YAML manifest with the help of the run command. The Pod should use the busybox:1.36.1 image and execute a shell command that renders the current date every 10 seconds in an infinite loop:

假设你想给一个尚未提供命令的镜像提供命令。与往常一样，有两种不同方式：命令式和声明式。我们将借助 run 命令生成 YAML manifest。该 Pod 应使用 busybox:1.36.1 镜像，并执行一个 shell 命令，在无限循环中每 10 秒渲染一次当前日期：

$ kubectl run mypod --image=busybox:1.36.1 -o yaml --dry-run=client \
  > pod.yaml -- /bin/sh -c "while true; do date; sleep 10; done"
— PDF p.142 —

You can see in the generated but condensed pod.yaml file shown in Example 9-4 that the command has been turned into an args attribute. Kubernetes specifies each argument on a single line.

在示例 9-4 所示的生成但精简过的 pod.yaml 文件中，你可以看到该命令已被转成 args 属性。Kubernetes 把每个参数单独放在一行。

Example 9-4. A YAML manifest containing an args attribute

示例 9-4. 包含 args 属性的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: mypod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: mypod
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    args:
    - /bin/sh
    - -c
    - while true; do date; sleep 10; done

You could have achieved the same result by a combination of the command and args attributes if you were to handcraft the YAML manifest. Example 9-5 shows a different approach.

如果你手工编写 YAML manifest，可以通过 command 和 args 属性的组合达到同样的结果。示例 9-5 展示了一种不同的方式。

Example 9-5. A YAML manifest containing command and args attributes

示例 9-5. 包含 command 和 args 属性的 YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: mypod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: mypod
    image: busybox:1.36.1
    command: ["/bin/sh"]
    args: ["-c", "while true; do date; sleep 10; done"]

You can quickly verify if the declared command actually does its job. First, create the Pod instance, then tail the logs:

你可以快速验证声明的命令是否真的起作用。先创建 Pod 实例，然后跟踪日志：

$ kubectl apply -f pod.yaml
pod/mypod created
$ kubectl logs mypod -f
Fri May 29 00:49:06 UTC 2020
Fri May 29 00:49:16 UTC 2020
Fri May 29 00:49:26 UTC 2020
...
— PDF p.143 —

Deleting a Pod删除 Pod

Sooner or later you’ll want to delete a Pod. During the exam, you may be asked to delete a Pod. Or possibly, you made a configuration mistake and want to start the question from scratch:

你迟早会想删除 Pod。考试中可能被要求删除 Pod。或者，你可能犯了配置错误，想从头开始答题：

$ kubectl delete pod hazelcast
pod "hazelcast" deleted

Keep in mind that Kubernetes tries to delete a Pod gracefully. This means that the Pod will try to finish active requests to the Pod to avoid unnecessary disruption to the end user. A graceful deletion operation can take anywhere from 5 to 30 seconds, time you don’t want to waste during the exam. See Chapter 1 for more information on how to speed up the process.

请记住 Kubernetes 会尝试优雅地删除 Pod。这意味着 Pod 会尝试完成对它的活跃请求，以避免对终端用户造成不必要的中断。优雅删除操作可能需要 5 到 30 秒，考试中你不想浪费这段时间。关于如何加速这一过程，参见第 1 章。

An alternative way to delete a Pod is to point the delete command to the YAML manifest you used to create it. The behavior is the same:

删除 Pod 的另一种方式是让 delete 命令指向你用于创建它的 YAML manifest。行为相同：

$ kubectl delete -f pod.yaml
pod "hazelcast" deleted

To save time during the exam, you can circumvent the grace period by adding the --now option to the delete command. Avoid using the --now flag in production Kubernetes environments.

为在考试中节省时间，你可以给 delete 命令加上 --now 选项来绕过宽限期。在生产 Kubernetes 环境中应避免使用 --now 标志。

Working with Namespaces使用命名空间

Namespaces are an API construct used to avoid naming collisions, and they represent a scope for object names. A good use case for namespaces is to isolate the objects by team or responsibility.

命名空间是一种 API 构造，用于避免命名冲突，它代表对象名称的作用域。命名空间的一个好用例是按团队或职责隔离对象。

Namespaces for objects对象的命名空间

The content in this chapter demonstrates the use of namespaces for Pod objects. Namespaces are not a concept applicable only to Pods, though. Most object types can be grouped by a namespace.

本章内容演示了命名空间用于 Pod 对象。但命名空间并非只适用于 Pod 的概念。大多数对象类型都可以按命名空间分组。

Most questions in the exam will ask you to execute the command in a specific namespace that has been set up for you. The following sections briefly touch on the basic operations needed to deal with a namespace.

考试中的大多数题目会要求你在一个为你设置好的特定命名空间中执行命令。接下来的小节简要介绍处理命名空间所需的基本操作。

— PDF p.144 —

Listing Namespaces列出命名空间

A Kubernetes cluster starts out with a couple of initial namespaces. You can list them with the following command:

Kubernetes 集群一开始就有几个初始命名空间。你可以用下面这条命令列出它们：

$ kubectl get namespaces
NAME              STATUS   AGE
default           Active   157d
kube-node-lease   Active   157d
kube-public       Active   157d
kube-system       Active   157d

The default namespace hosts objects that haven’t been assigned to an explicit namespace. Namespaces starting with the prefix kube- are not considered end user-namespaces. They have been created by the Kubernetes system.

default 命名空间承载尚未分配到显式命名空间的对象。以 kube- 为前缀的命名空间不被视为终端用户命名空间，它们是由 Kubernetes 系统创建的。

Creating and Using a Namespace创建并使用命名空间

To create a new namespace, use the create namespace command. The following command uses the name code-red:

要创建新命名空间，使用 create namespace 命令。下面这条命令使用名称 code-red：

$ kubectl create namespace code-red
namespace/code-red created
$ kubectl get namespace code-red
NAME       STATUS   AGE
code-red   Active   16s

Example 9-6 shows the corresponding representation as a YAML manifest.

示例 9-6 展示了对应的 YAML manifest 表示。

Example 9-6. Namespace YAML manifest

示例 9-6. 命名空间 YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: code-red

Once the namespace is in place, you can create objects within it. You can do so with the command-line option --namespace or its short-form -n. The following commands create a new Pod in the namespace code-red and then list the available Pods in the namespace:

命名空间就绪后，你可以在其中创建对象。你可以使用命令行选项 --namespace 或其简写 -n 来做到。下面的命令在 code-red 命名空间中创建一个新 Pod，然后列出该命名空间中可用的 Pod：

$ kubectl run pod --image=nginx:1.25.1 -n code-red
pod/pod created
$ kubectl get pods -n code-red
NAME   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod    1/1     Running   0          13s
— PDF p.145 —

Setting a Namespace Preference设置命名空间偏好

Providing the --namespace or -n command-line option for every command is tedious and error-prone. You can set a permanent namespace preference if you know that you need to interact with a specific namespace you are responsible for. The first command shown sets the permanent namespace code-red. The second command renders the currently set permanent namespace:

对每条命令都提供 --namespace 或 -n 命令行选项既繁琐又容易出错。如果你知道需要与自己负责的某个特定命名空间交互，可以设置一个永久命名空间偏好。所示第一条命令设置永久命名空间 code-red。第二条命令渲染当前设置的永久命名空间：

$ kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=code-red
Context "minikube" modified.
$ kubectl config view --minify | grep namespace:
    namespace: code-red

Subsequent kubectl executions do not have to spell out the namespace code-red:

后续的 kubectl 执行不必再写出 code-red 命名空间：

$ kubectl get pods
NAME   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
pod    1/1     Running   0          13s

You can always switch back to the default namespace or another custom namespace using the config set-context command:

你随时可以使用 config set-context 命令切回 default 命名空间或另一个自定义命名空间：

$ kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=default
Context "minikube" modified.

Deleting a Namespace删除命名空间

Deleting a namespace has a cascading effect on the object existing in it. Deleting a namespace will automatically delete its objects:

删除命名空间会对其中存在的对象产生级联效应。删除命名空间会自动删除其对象：

$ kubectl delete namespace code-red
namespace "code-red" deleted
$ kubectl get pods -n code-red
No resources found in code-red namespace.

Summary本章小结

The exam puts a strong emphasis on the concept of a Pod, a Kubernetes primitive responsible for running an application in a container. A Pod can define one or many containers that use a container image. Upon its creation, the container image is resolved and used to bootstrap the application. Every Pod can be further customized with the relevant YAML configuration.

考试非常强调 Pod 这一概念——它是负责在容器中运行应用的 Kubernetes 原语。一个 Pod 可以定义一个或多个使用某容器镜像的容器。Pod 创建时，容器镜像被解析并用于引导应用。每个 Pod 都可以用相关 YAML 配置进一步自定义。

— PDF p.146 —

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Know how to interact with Pods: A Pod runs an application inside of a container. You can check on the status and the configuration of the Pod by inspecting the object with the kubectl get or kubectl describe commands. Get familiar with the lifecycle phases of a Pod to be able to quickly diagnose errors. The command kubectl logs can be used to download the container log information without having to shell into the container. Use the command kubectl exec to further explore the container environment, e.g., to check on processes or to examine files.掌握如何与 Pod 交互：Pod 在容器内运行应用。你可以用 kubectl get 或 kubectl describe 命令检查对象，以查看 Pod 的状态和配置。熟悉 Pod 的生命周期阶段，以便快速诊断错误。kubectl logs 命令可用于下载容器日志信息，而无需 shell 进入容器。使用 kubectl exec 命令进一步探查容器环境，例如检查进程或查看文件。
  • Understand advanced Pod configuration options: Sometimes you have to start with the YAML manifest of a Pod and then create the Pod declaratively. This could be the case if you wanted to provide environment variables to the container or declare a custom command. Practice different configuration options by copy-pasting relevant code snippets from the Kubernetes documentation.理解高级 Pod 配置选项：有时你必须先从 Pod 的 YAML manifest 入手，然后以声明式方式创建 Pod。例如你想给容器提供环境变量或声明自定义命令时就可能如此。通过从 Kubernetes 文档复制粘贴相关代码片段来练习不同的配置选项。
  • Practice using a custom namespace: Most questions in the exam will ask you to work within a given namespace. You need to understand how to interact with that namespace from kubectl using the options --namespace and -n. To avoid accidentally working on the wrong namespace, know how to permanently set a namespace.练习使用自定义命名空间：考试中的大多数题目会要求你在给定命名空间中工作。你需要理解如何在 kubectl 中使用 --namespace 和 -n 选项与该命名空间交互。为避免不小心在错误的命名空间上操作，要知道如何永久设置一个命名空间。

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. Create a new Pod named nginx running the image nginx:1.17.10. Expose the container port 80. The Pod should live in the namespace named j43. Get the details of the Pod including its IP address. Create a temporary Pod that uses the busybox:1.36.1 image to execute a wget command inside of the container. The wget command should access the endpoint exposed by the nginx container. You should see the HTML response body rendered in the terminal. Get the logs of the nginx container. Add the environment variables DB_URL=postgresql://mydb:5432 and DB_USERNAME=admin to the container of the nginx Pod. Open a shell for the nginx container and inspect the contents of the current directory ls -l. Exit out of the container.创建一个名为 nginx 的新 Pod，运行镜像 nginx:1.17.10。暴露容器端口 80。该 Pod 应位于名为 j43 的命名空间中。获取该 Pod 的详情，包括其 IP 地址。创建一个临时 Pod，使用 busybox:1.36.1 镜像在容器内执行 wget 命令。wget 命令应访问 nginx 容器所暴露的端点。你应在终端中看到渲染出的 HTML 响应体。获取 nginx 容器的日志。给 nginx Pod 的容器添加环境变量 DB_URL=postgresql://mydb:5432 和 DB_USERNAME=admin。为 nginx 容器打开 shell，用 ls -l 查看当前目录内容。退出容器。
  2. Create a YAML manifest for a Pod named loop in the namespace j43 that runs the busybox:1.36.1 image in a container. The container should run the following command: for i in {1..10}; do echo "Welcome $i times"; done. Create the Pod from the YAML manifest. What’s the status of the Pod? Edit the Pod named loop. Change the command to run in an endless loop. Each iteration should echo the current date. Inspect the events and the status of the Pod loop.在命名空间 j43 中为名为 loop 的 Pod 创建一份 YAML manifest，该 Pod 在容器中运行 busybox:1.36.1 镜像。容器应运行以下命令：for i in {1..10}; do echo "Welcome $i times"; done。从 YAML manifest 创建该 Pod。Pod 的状态是什么？编辑名为 loop 的 Pod。把命令改为在无限循环中运行。每次迭代应 echo 当前日期。检查 Pod loop 的事件和状态。
— PDF p.147 —
